concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to download and parse PlanBench‑XL and *extract* the implicit‑failure subset that already exists in the benchmark. The current tasks (T005‑T006) create that subset by injecting errors into successful tasks rather than extracting an existing implicit‑failure set, leaving FR‑001 uncovered.

FR-002 mandates that the failure‑signature JSON index be derived *strictly* from the ground‑truth task definitions. Tasks T006‑T007 build the index from the synthetically injected error patterns, not from the original ground truth, so FR‑002 is not satisfied.
